name: inspira-gradient-button
title: Gradient Button
description: A pill or rounded button wrapped in a blurred conic gradient that rotates, so the outline cycles through colours. Fill, radius, border width and speed are configurable.
use: A primary call to action needs to stand out on a dark page without changing its layout.
avoid: The blurred glow is soft and imprecise, and the busy colours can clash with a strict brand palette.
a11y: It is a native button with a real text label, but the border animation never stops and no focus style is set. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two dark buttons sit on a black stage. One is a rounded rectangle and one a full pill; each is ringed by a bright, soft gradient border, rainbow on the left and blue-violet-pink on the right, holding white text.
behaves: The gradient ring rotates continuously around each button, so the border colours drift and glow while the button itself stays put and the label stays fixed.
customise: colors, duration, borderWidth, borderRadius, blur and bgColor are props; the conic keyframe and inner padding are fixed.
weight: light: A single pseudo-element rotating a blurred conic gradient with CSS.
demo: Get early access and Explore templates.
polishWhy: Bright and smooth, but it is a familiar rainbow-border trick with plain labels.
